_about: Mistake (consequence-sandbox) fragment for awareness episode E15 (Shadow IT), the full-episode analogue of e4/attack.json but with no attacker and no 04 phish target. It carries the ENG-04 sandbox: the four everyday Friday shortcuts the learner takes or refuses (awarenessEpisode.mistake) and the montage flip mode (flip). These keys are full-episode-only (the defend-only shell drops mistake and flip, per ENG-04). The montage text itself (strings.flipMontageByChoice) is erb-only and is in full_only.json; flipHeading ('Six months later') stays in the defend.json fragment (E11 section 10a / ENG-04). The JSON below is identical to the mistake and flip blocks in full_only.json; this file is the fragment the wiring agent reads at the e4/attack.json location, full_only.json is the paste-into-the-full-erb hand-off.
_wiring: The wiring agent pastes awarenessEpisode.mistake and awarenessEpisode.flip into the FULL erb's social.awarenessEpisode (sibling of mfa/defend/strings). Neither key appears in the defend-only shell. Exactly one option per beat has safe:true (ENG-04 lint); the safe option is deliberately placed first in some beats and second in others (beat 1 second, beat 2 first, beat 3 second, beat 4 first) so it is not always first (AGENT_RULES_CONTENT: sandbox options must not list the safe option first every time). flipBeat is personal_email, the one consequential choice quoted back as the montage headline; the montage still shows every beat.

beats.situation: The share has crawled to a halt and the pack is due Monday. Colin: "Just email the pack to your personal address and finish it off at home." The compose window offers "Me (personal)" in the autocomplete.

options.label: Ask Nilesh about remote access and work from home that way
Send the pack to your personal email to finish at home

beats.situation: Colin: "Add the client's night contact to the drivers' group chat on our own phones. It's how we pass round addresses and photos of signed notes anyway."

options.label: Add the client's contact to the drivers' personal group chat
Ask IT for an approved team channel, and share the address there

beats.situation: A visiting surveyor holds out their own USB stick with the site drawings on it: "Just pop it in your laptop, it's quicker than emailing."

options.label: Plug the visitor's stick into your laptop
Ask them to send the drawings through the firm's file-sharing link instead

options.label: Hold off, and ask IT to move the rota into the team space
Add this week's slots to the free app, and sort the rest later
